purpose: Acquisition only. Fix an immutable identity for one legacy Angular application, prove the acquired bytes against the pinned git content, and record one truthful baseline install and production build. No product, adapter, or migration work was performed.

two independent fetches produced byte-identical archives

chain.what: offline reconciliation, and the Git LFS precheck the factoriolab lane taught
chain.established: all 250 extracted files hash, as git blob objects, to exactly the shas the tree records for those paths: 0 missing, 0 extra, 0 mismatched, single archive root, no path traversal or absolute entries. Normalized manifest sha256 f7f3a188bedde5719c369c1b0ce7a8a6ca5588cc50a4fb0dfb2fe8cf08a5ad8a. No .gitattributes exists, no path is routed through the LFS filter, and no blob carries an LFS pointer header — so unlike the factoriolab fixture this tree is self-contained and no media-host deviation was needed.

.nvmrc pins Node 16; no Node 16 runtime existed in this workspace, so one was acquired and its sha256 (6a5c4108475871362d742b988566f3fe307f6a67ce14634eb3fbceb4f9eea88c) checked against the entry for the same filename in the release SHASUMS256.txt before it was extracted or run. Native arm64, no translation layer.

chain.what: baseline install and production build in the declared legacy cell
chain.established: npm ci succeeded from the committed lockfileVersion 2 (2729 packages installed, exit 0). `npx ng build --configuration production` failed with exit 1 in about a second at builder schema validation: the committed production configuration sets extractCss, an option removed from the Angular 13 browser builder schema.

The repository's own `npm run build` — unmodified source, no configuration selected — succeeded with exit 0 and 32 dist files. Then one labeled deviation deleted the single extractCss key from angular.json in the git-ignored working tree, and the production build succeeded with exit 0 and 24 dist files. The dependency closure and application code were untouched in both.
